assumptions: Dimorphite-DL's (Ropp et al. 2019) site library and pKa ranges.
limits: Groups outside the library are left as drawn.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which protonation states does this molecule take across this pH window?

description: Enumerate a small molecule's protonation states across a pH window with Dimorphite-DL (Ropp et al. 2019): each ionisable group it recognizes (substructures with pKa means and spreads taken from measured pKa values) is kept protonated, deprotonated or both, and every combination is returned as SMILES. Reproduces Dimorphite-DL 2.1.0, including that it neutralizes charged groups first and keeps only the part it neutralized.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

max_variants.description: stop enumerating past this many states (later groups are then not visited).

molecule.description: the structure: SMILES or a molfile.

ph_max.description: upper end of the pH window.

ph_min.description: lower end of the pH window.

precision.description: how many standard deviations of each group's pKa widen its window, 0–10.

name: enumerate_protonation_states

capped.description: true when the enumeration stopped at max_variants

sites.description: per ionisable site: Dimorphite name, SMARTS, each pKa (mean, stdev, state) and its atoms on the input (0-based, implicit hydrogens), or null when they do not map

states.description: every protonation state as canonical SMILES, sorted

summary.description: the enumeration in words, generated from this run, with its caveats
